finalText:
**Build's clean now.** Exit 0, 0 errors.

Found two real bugs from the bundler bump, both in the link stage:

- [src/core/options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Threw on `undefined.toFixed()`.
- [src/net/retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) threw on `undefined` flags instead of treating unset as `false`.

Rest of the noise is just deprecation warnings, harmless. `retry budget resolved to 3` and `backoff disabled` both come back correctly now.
